claims.head: The Capitals want Wilson head to head with Suzuki
claims.call: The Capitals’ L1 (Wilson, Tuch and Strome) spends at least 55% of its 5-on-5 time against the Canadiens’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Capitals keep sending Wilson’s line (Wilson, Tuch and Strome) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Spencer Carbery has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Canadiens’ first line is Suzuki, Caufield and Slafkovský.
claims.nums: At home: 55% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 31% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Spencer Carbery likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canadiens’ first line.

notes.text: I. Demidov is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. K. Dach has taken his spot beside A. Newhook and J. Slafkovský.
M. Matheson is out (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. L. Hutson has taken his spot beside N. Dobson.
O. Beck was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside J. Evans and K. Dach.
A. Xhekaj has started killing penalties: on the ice for 25% of the team’s shorthanded time in 6 games, up from 6% last season.
P. Dubois is out (illness) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-six forward. D. Strome has taken his spot beside T. Wilson and A. Tuch.
M. Roy is on injured reserve and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-four defenseman. T. Liljegren has taken his spot beside J. Chychrun.

WSH.head: The Capitals start a half-step behind
WSH.body: Montréal has been out-chancing opponents lately, while Washington will be without Dubois. Washington has home-ice advantage, while Montréal will be without Demidov, though. The Capitals can tip it if they get good looks.

MTL.head: The Canadiens start a half-step ahead
MTL.body: Montréal has been out-chancing opponents lately, while Washington will be without Dubois. Washington has home-ice advantage, while Montréal will be without Demidov, though. It’s still close, though: the Capitals can make it interesting if they get good looks.

story.head: Hutson against Hutson
paras: The Capitals are 3-3-0. The Canadiens have won two in a row.
